T: Brook trout on the train, corn on the run.
D: A New York ad man is mistaken for a government agent and chased across the country.
P: Serve the trout when Roger meets Eve in the dining car.
S: the Plaza bar where the mix-up starts
Choux pastry beaten with gruyère, piped into small puffs and baked at 200C until hollow and golden.
Celery sticks, radishes, olives, pickles and carrot curls on crushed ice with a little dish of cream cheese.
Crop duster corn fritters with chilli jam
the crop duster chasing Roger through the cornfields

Sweet corn kernels in a light batter with spring onion, coriander and chilli, fried golden in spoonfuls, with sour cream and sticky chilli jam. Cut the kernels from 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 100ml milk into a thick batter. Stir in the corn, 3 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped tablespoons for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Serve with 150g sour cream and 100g chilli jam.
M: Roger's order on the train with Eve
Whole trout dusted in flour, pan-fried in butter and finished with toasted almonds, lemon and parsley.
Mount Rushmore hot roast beef sandwich
the visitor centre cafeteria below the monument

Slow-roasted beef sliced thin on thick white bread, smothered in hot red wine gravy, with creamy mashed potato and buttered green beans. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1kg beef blade or topside roast with oil, salt and pepper and roast 50 minutes for medium. Rest 15 minutes, then slice thin. Whisk 2 tbsp pan fat with 2 tbsp flour, then 100ml red wine and 400ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes. Mash 800g potatoes with butter and milk. Boil 300g green beans. Lay the beef on 8 slices of thick white bread, pour over the gravy and serve with mash and beans.
W: a showpiece on the dining car menu
Sponge base topped with vanilla ice cream, covered in meringue and browned in a very hot oven just before serving.
K: Roger's drink in the dining car
Gin stirred with dry vermouth over ice, strained into a chilled glass with a cocktail onion. Sparkling water and onions for anyone off the gin.

s.note: the Plaza bar where the mix-up starts
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour until it leaves the pan, cool 5 minutes and beat in 2 eggs, then 80g grated gruyère. Pipe 20 small puffs and bake at 200C for 22 minutes until hollow and golden.

Cut 4 celery sticks and 2 carrots into sticks and trim 1 bunch radishes. Arrange on crushed ice with 150g mixed olives and 4 dill pickles cut into spears, and add a small dish of 125g cream cheese for spreading.

m.note: Roger's order on the train with Eve
m.how: Dust 4 cleaned whole trout in flour and season. Fry 2 at a time in 40g butter for 4 minutes a side until crisp. Brown another 40g butter with 40g flaked almonds, add the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley and spoon over the fish.

w.note: a showpiece on the dining car menu
w.how: Lay a 20cm sponge round on a tray and dome 1L firm vanilla ice cream on top, then freeze. Whisk 4 egg whites with 200g sugar to stiff, glossy peaks. Cover the ice cream completely in meringue and bake at 230C for 4 minutes until browned. Serve straight away.

d.note: Roger's drink in the dining car
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds and strain into a chilled glass with a cocktail onion. Pour sparkling water over ice with onions for anyone off the gin.
